title: Peter Wildeford’s AGI Timelines Model
description: Probability-threshold dates from a frozen run of Peter Wildeford’s METR-based Monte Carlo model of AGI timelines.

version.label: Default-model extraction from commit 664e1cec (2026-02-09)
version.notes: Frozen 100,000-sample extraction from upstream commit 664e1cec269c49534e3a59860e1f096b7b6b7b2e. Calendar events represent cumulative percentile crossings, not five separate AGI arrivals.

milestones.title: Model distribution reaches 10% cumulative AGI probability
milestones.summary: Ten percent of a frozen 100,000-run snapshot of Wildeford’s default METR-based model reaches its AGI criterion by this date.
milestones.source_context: AGI Timelines Model default Monte Carlo distribution, upstream commit 664e1cec (2026-02-09)
milestones.normalization_rationale: This is the exact extracted percentile date from the frozen model extraction.
milestones.uncertainty: The model result is highly sensitive to its benchmark extrapolation, AGI task threshold, reliability, domain, and acceleration assumptions.
